title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

providers.name: MuleSoft Anypoint
providers.scope_notes: Covers MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. Anypoint Platform control plane (US/EU/Gov); IP allowlist only US/EU commercial; audit export needs Anypoint Integration Advanced or Titanium.

auth_paths.name: Environment / business group client ID and client secret

authentication.summary: Each environment and the root business group has a client ID/secret used to pair customer-hosted Mule runtimes and API gateways; organization clients can get tokens via client_credentials. Root business group credentials grant permissions across all child business groups.

ip_restriction.boundary: The org IP allowlist covers only user sign-ins with Anypoint credentials; environment credentials are not covered. No other IP control documented.

renewal.summary: Secret is reused; reset via KB procedure or support.

administration.summary: Org admins can view the values; changing the secret points to a Salesforce Help article or support.

offboard.details: Credentials belong to an environment or business group, not a user.

inventory.details: Access Management > Environments shows each environment's client ID; Organization tab shows org/business group credentials.

log_sources.name: Anypoint Platform audit log (Access Management > Audit Log, Audit Log Query API)
log_sources.notes: Default retention 1 year (6 years for orgs before 2023-07-10), configurable 30-2190 days; export via Telemetry Exporter needs Anypoint Integration Advanced or Titanium.

anomaly_cues: Unknown Mule runtime or gateway registering to an environment

containment.steps: Reset environment client_secret per KB or contact support.
